tasks.label: publish-iis-sb
args: $site='\\68d-mmslpm\cms'; $flag=Join-Path $site 'maintenance.flag'; $offline=Join-Path $site 'app_offline.htm'; $dll=Join-Path $site 'CMS.Server.dll'; function Remove-Verified($p){ for($i=0;$i -lt 20;$i++){ if(-not (Test-Path $p)){ return }; Remove-Item $p -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500 } }; $shutdownAt=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(60).ToUnixTimeMilliseconds(); Set-Content -Path $flag -Value $shutdownAt -Force; Write-Host 'Countdown active, app live. Waiting 60s...'; Start-Sleep -Seconds 60; Copy-Item '${workspaceFolder}\app_offline.htm' $offline -Force; Write-Host 'Update page live, app stopping. Waiting for DLL lock to release...'; for($i=0;$i -lt 40;$i++){ try{ $fs=[System.IO.File]::Open($dll,'Open','ReadWrite','None'); $fs.Close(); break }catch{ Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500 } }; Write-Host 'Publishing...'; try { dotnet publish '${workspaceFolder}\CMS.Server\CMS.Server.csproj' -c Release -o $site } finally { Remove-Verified $offline; Remove-Verified $flag; Write-Host ('Cleanup done. app_offline present: ' + (Test-Path $offline)) }
